description: A carefree fighter with the power to manipulate fire, Kyo Kusanagi was the scion of one of the three families that had originally locked away the creature known as Orochi - and the fiercest rival against Iori Yagami, who channeled its dark power. After the bloody events occurring at the end of the last tournament, Kyo had decided to enter the latest battle with his faithful friends. To their surprise, they were first attacked by a berserk Iori, then by another team who claimed to be the inheritors of Orochi's power. At the climax of the tournament, Orochi reemerged into the world in his chosen avatar's body, ready to destroy mankind. Only Kyo and his companions stood in the way of certain annihilation, but they weren't going down without a fight.
summon:
Like the raging flames of the sun...
That is the fist of the Kusanagis!
fusion:
That was pretty good.
I haven't burnt that hot in a while!
evolution:
Do you understand my power now?
Brute strength alone can't control these flames!
